name: @pmp/mobile
description: The Android apps: one Gradle project, a module per app. The kiosk app runs the server in a foreground service and shows the kiosk; the parents' app shows /parent from the family's server (ADR 0032, ADR 0033, ADR 0035).

scripts.apk:kiosk: npm run fetch-node && npm run stage && node scripts/gradle.mjs :kiosk:assembleDebug
scripts.release:kiosk: npm run fetch-node && npm run stage && node scripts/gradle.mjs :kiosk:assembleRelease :kiosk:bundleRelease
scripts.apk:release: npm run fetch-node && npm run stage && node scripts/gradle.mjs :kiosk:assembleRelease
scripts.bundle:release: npm run fetch-node && npm run stage && node scripts/gradle.mjs :kiosk:bundleRelease
